simple.summary: מֵידְבָא (Mêydᵉbâʼ) means Medeba , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Chr 19 7.

definitions.full: H4311. Medeba מֵידְבָא proper name, of a location city in Moab (MI 8 מהדבה ) — Num 21:30 ; Isa 15:2 ; Josh 13:9 , 16 assigned to Reuben ( ᵐ5 Δαιδαβαν , Μαιδαβα ᵐ5 L Μεδαβα ); 1Chr 19:7 meeting-place of Ammonites ( ᵐ5 Μαιθαβα , A ᵐ5 L Μηδαβα ). מֵידָד see II. ידד .
